text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick heads up — rolling out the revised Employee Handbook & Compliance refresher the week after next. This is mandatory for all full-time and part-time employees. We plan live sessions + recorded version + short quiz. Please reply with: 1) preferred live slot window (morning/late morning/afternoon) 2) any language/localization needs 3) if you need an in-office room.

Ravi K: Late morning (UTC+5:30) works best. Can we get the deck in plain text and captions? I'm remote.

Elena S: Afternoon EMEA preferred (UTC+2). Also managers will want completion exports per team.

Tom (Hiring): For new hires, can we have a condensed 20-min onboarding variant? Hiring ops needs to tag hires as completed automatically.

Claire (Legal): Important: new handbook section on data retention and vendor data processing needs to be included. Also require French + German translations before broad rollout in EU.

room-bot: Room availability check: 2 x huddle rooms and 1 x training room free 10:00-11:30 local on Tue/Wed.

Maya (People Ops): Plan: three live windows (APAC early morning, Global late morning, EMEA afternoon). Live session 40 min + 15 min Q&A. Recording + accessible slide text posted within 24 hours. Quiz 15 questions, pass threshold 80%. Managers get weekly completion CSV until 95% target reached.

Tom (Hiring): For new hires, agree on condensed 20-min session + auto-assign the quiz through LMS. Can we add a manager confirmation checkbox for hires before marking complete?

Maya (People Ops): Yes — hiring ops will be able to mark onboarding exceptions in the tracker. We'll provide an API export for HRIS tagging.

Ravi K: Also need Spanish translation for LATAM teams, please.

Claire (Legal): Approve priority translations: French, German, Spanish. Other languages require manager justification and business case.

Elena S: Accessibility ask: spoken language transcript + slides in high-contrast and a screen-reader-friendly text file.

Maya (People Ops): Confirmed. We'll produce captions, transcript, plain-text slides, and a high-contrast PDF. If anyone needs live interpretation, DM me and we'll evaluate budget.

Facilities: @Maya for in-office sessions we need headcounts 72h prior and AV check one day before. Room-bot shows training room has capacity 40.

Tom (Hiring): Can you add an opt-in sign-up link for the condensed new-hire slot so we can plan attendance?

Maya (People Ops): Creating sign-up now — will post link in #new-hires and add calendar invite. Managers: you'll get a short guide for nudges and how to run a 1:1 recap for hires.

Claire (Legal): Also require an attestation checkbox in the quiz for those handling PII that they understand the retention policy.

Ravi K: For the quiz, can it be open-book? Some policy items are nuanced and context-specific.

Maya (People Ops): Yes open-book ok. Quiz tests comprehension not memorization. Failures trigger remediation and a retake window of 7 days.

Elena S: Timeline: when will translations be available?

Maya (People Ops): Target: French/German/Spanish complete within 10 business days after initial session. Localization requests outside of those three need manager approval by EOD this Friday.

Tom (Hiring): RSVP: I'll reserve 10 seats for condensed new-hire session on Wed 10:00 local.

room-bot: RSVP recorded: Tom (Hiring) -> training room Wed 10:00. Current RSVP total for live sessions: 18

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. Final note — we'll publish a short FAQ and an escalation contact (people-ops+compliance) with the recording. Please submit any handbook wording concerns to Claire by Tuesday.
